judgment.reason: Re-reading the entry as '□□Abstract(小四号Times New Roman， 加粗):……            (五号Times New Roman)' with Abstract as the unit title (small-four Times New Roman bold). The two □ are leading spacing symbols only; they preserve indentation requirement, do not enter final content. 'Abstract(小四号Times New Roman， 加粗)' is the fixed English abstract heading: 'Abstract' is the fixed label and the parenthetical '小四号Times New Roman， 加粗' is the format obligation for that heading; together they form one fixed_label preserving the required font/size/bold requirement on Abstract. After the colon, '……' is the placeholder indicating the position where the English abstract body is to be inserted; it occupies the value slot for the abstract content, and the surrounding spaces are part of the original layout. The trailing '(五号Times New Roman)' on the same line specifies the font/size obligation for the abstract body that follows. Within this single source entry, the colon ':……' sequence is best interpreted as the explicit value-position prompt for the English abstract body: there is no separate independent label, and the placeholder text itself occupies the final value position, so the colon-prefix and the '……' form a continuous fill_slot binding abstract.en, while the trailing format note describes the obligation on that fill_slot rather than entering the final body text. Restating the entry as a sequence of consecutive substrings, the first is the two spacing glyphs, the second is the Abstract heading with its inline font/size/bold format note (both fixed heading and its styling requirement, kept as fixed_label together since the parenthetical is not a separate fillable position), the third is the colon-plus-ellipsis placeholder occupying the English abstract value position with the embedded multiple-space layout run, and the fourth is the trailing font/size note '(五号Times New Roman)' as a separate style_only obligation that applies to the abstract body fill. This preserves the fixed heading label, binds abstract.en to the ellipsis value position, and keeps both font obligations (heading 小四号Times New Roman 加粗, body 五号Times New Roman) intact for the host. The final template therefore reads 'Abstract' as a fixed bold small-four Times New Roman heading followed by the student's English abstract body set in five-point Times New Roman, with the leading □ symbols not entering the final text.
